examples.label: Feature checklist inside a plan card
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-list-group" site="Global" id="listgroup-plan-features" size="small">
  <.component component_name="chelekom-li" site="Global" padding="extra_small" icon="hero-check-circle" icon_class="size-4 text-emerald-600">Unlimited projects</.component>
  <.component component_name="chelekom-li" site="Global" padding="extra_small" icon="hero-check-circle" icon_class="size-4 text-emerald-600">Ten team members</.component>
  <.component component_name="chelekom-li" site="Global" padding="extra_small" icon="hero-check-circle" icon_class="size-4 text-emerald-600">Nightly backups kept for 30 days</.component>
  <.component component_name="chelekom-li" site="Global" padding="extra_small" icon="hero-check-circle" icon_class="size-4 text-emerald-600">Email support within one business day</.component>
</.component>

examples.label: Numbered onboarding steps
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-list-group" site="Global" id="listgroup-onboarding" size="small">
  <.component component_name="chelekom-li" site="Global" padding="extra_small" count={1}>Create your workspace</.component>
  <.component component_name="chelekom-li" site="Global" padding="extra_small" count={2}>Invite the people you publish with</.component>
  <.component component_name="chelekom-li" site="Global" padding="extra_small" count={3}>Connect your domain</.component>
  <.component component_name="chelekom-li" site="Global" padding="extra_small" count={4}>Publish your first page</.component>
</.component>
